words: /faɪn/ adj.. 好的；晴朗的（描述天气好或身体状况好）
/klaʊd/ n.. 云（常用复数形式 clouds）
/skaɪ/ n.. 天空（常与介词 in 搭配使用）
/sʌn/ n.. 太阳（与定冠词 the 连用，表示独一无二的事物）
/ʃaɪn/ v.. 照耀（现在分词为 shining）
/bəʊt/ n.. 小船（一般指较小的船）
/ʃɪp/ n.. 轮船（一般指大的轮船）
/ˈeərəpleɪn/ n.. 飞机（英式英语，美式英语为 airplane）
/ˈfæməli/ n.. 家庭（可指数个家庭成员）
phrases: It is a fine day today.
There are some clouds in the sky.
Mr. Jones is with his family.
琼斯先生和家人在一起。
They are walking over the bridge.
Sally is looking at a big ship.
莎莉正在看一艘大轮船。
The ship is going under the bridge.
The aeroplane is flying over the river.

grammar.f: There is/are + 名词 + 地点
grammar.d: 表示某地存在某物或某人 表示客观存在的'有'，与 have/has 不同
ex: There are some clouds in the sky.
There are some boats on the river.

grammar.d: 表示正在发生的动作 描述说话时正在进行的动作
ex: They are walking over the bridge.
The ship is going under the bridge.

grammar.k: 方位介词 over 和 under
grammar.d: over 表示在...上方（不接触），under 表示在...下方 描述物体之间的相对位置关系
ex: The ship is going under the bridge.
The aeroplane is flying over the river.

patterns.p: There is/are + 名词 + 介词短语
o: There are some clouds in the sky.
im: There is a book on the table.
There are some students in the classroom.

patterns.p: 主语 + be + 动词-ing + 介词短语
o: The ship is going under the bridge.
im: The birds are flying over the trees.
The children are playing in the park.
孩子们正在公园里玩耍。

patterns.p: 主语 + is/are looking at + 名词
o: Sally is looking at a big ship.
莎莉正在看一艘大轮船。
im: He is looking at the picture.
They are looking at the airplane.
